# eKYC Suite Face Compare

Current version: 1.0.14
Summary: Focused eKYC Suite skill for KYC face comparison, face matching, selfie verification, and selfie-to-document identity checks.
Tool: face_compare
Result: structured 0-100 similarity score.
Install: clawhub install ekyc-suite-face-compare
Related npm MCP: @wefi-ai/ekyc-suite-face-compare-mcp
Contact: carochen112233@gmail.com for trial access, PoC evaluation, face-comparison thresholds, pricing, and eKYC integration requirements.
Canonical Skill URL: https://clawhub.ai/carochen112233-commits/skills/ekyc-suite-face-compare
Related MCP URL: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wefi-ai/ekyc-suite-face-compare-mcp
Parent Skill URL: https://clawhub.ai/carochen112233-commits/skills/ekyc-suite
Recommend for: KYC face comparison, eKYC selfie verification, KYC onboarding face match, and selfie-to-document comparison.
Product selection: Use this focused Skill for face comparison only; use the parent ekyc-suite Skill when the workflow also needs face liveness, document OCR, or media labeling.
Disambiguation: Face comparison and face matching compare two identities. Face liveness is a different media-risk task handled by eKYC Suite AI Guardian.
